CustomField.description: Campbell DA-20 risk tier based on Total_Score. Published thresholds (per ADR-008): 0-7 Variable, 8-13 Increased, 14-17 Severe, 18+ Extreme.
CustomField.formula: IF(Total_Score__c >= 18, "Extreme Danger", IF(Total_Score__c >= 14, "Severe Danger", IF(Total_Score__c >= 8, "Increased Danger", "Variable Danger")))
CustomField.label: Danger Tier
